experience.role: Software Engineering Manager - Technical Leadership Role
experience.description: Leading the internalization and technical audit of a legacy third-party system, gaining full ownership of architecture and codebase.
achievements: Led the internalization and technical audit of a mission-critical legacy public-sector platform serving 28 municipal departments, 6 independent government-linked organizations and the mayor’s office, taking ownership of architecture, infrastructure and codebases previously maintained by a third-party vendor, reducing operational dependency and enabling long-term modernization initiatives.

Defined and executed an incremental modernization strategy for a heavily undocumented Java 8 monolithic ecosystem composed of two monoliths and five major modules, introducing FastAPI-based microservices and React applications while maintaining uninterrupted operations for a platform supporting hundreds of thousands of users and more than 6 million citizen-service records.

Architected the organization’s current and target AWS cloud environments, designing scalable, resilient and multi-tenant infrastructure strategies documented through D2 architecture diagrams, while contributing to cloud governance, cost estimation and infrastructure forecasting initiatives.

Acted as the primary technical owner for AWS operations and cloud migration efforts, managing IAM access controls, S3 provisioning, billing alerts and infrastructure configuration as part of the transition from fully on-premise operations to AWS-based environments.

Redesigned production deployment architecture by implementing AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB) strategies supporting blue/green deployments and rollback capabilities, significantly reducing deployment risk and minimizing service disruption for business-critical citizen-service operations.

Transformed a fully manual deployment process that previously required manual code extraction, WAR generation, SSH-based deployment and production intervention into automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines with build, testing, deployment orchestration, Docker image promotion, CDXGen SBOM generation, Trivy security scanning and Dockle compliance scanning reducing deployment execution from approximately one day to minutes.

Led the migration of the platform's environment off a manual docker-compose setup onto a single-node Kubernetes (k3s) cluster managed through GitOps with Argo CD, replacing imperative push-based deployments with a pull-based reconciliation model — CI publishes images to GHCR and commits the image digest, and the cluster continuously self-heals to the declared state — while consolidating an in-cluster PostgreSQL/PostGIS database with automated restoration from S3 dumps, Traefik path-based routing and cert-manager/Let's Encrypt TLS.

Codified the platform as reproducible Infrastructure as Code through environment-agnostic bootstrap scripts (EC2 user-data + a single idempotent k3s bring-up) parameterized for development, staging and production, enabling a complete working environment — cluster, database, applications and operational tooling (pgAdmin, Metabase, Headlamp) — to be provisioned from zero with one command, guaranteeing environment parity and eliminating a legacy hand-built staging setup.

Designed and implemented a role-based access control (RBAC) layer for the legacy platform — modeling access profiles, functionalities and per-user/per-sector role mappings with self-service administration screens — and diagnosed and resolved a production-blocking authentication regression rooted in a silently-swallowed database-migration failure, restoring login for all users and hardening the migration process.

Established engineering standards for environment management, deployment workflows, versioning strategies and release governance, improving delivery consistency and creating repeatable operational processes for development and production environments.

Designed and implemented backend services using FastAPI (Python) and frontend applications with React and TypeScript, enabling the gradual decomposition of legacy services and accelerating delivery of new features integrated with existing systems.

Led the redesign of the platform's data and form architecture by introducing an Entity-Attribute-Value (EAV) model and a JSONB-based conditional workflow engine, eliminating the need for code deployments and database migrations for most client-specific customizations; enabling business teams to configure fields, forms and dynamic questionnaires independently, reducing operational bottlenecks and significantly increasing the scalability and adaptability of the platform.

Designed the architecture and initial implementation of an AI-driven NLP chatbot platform using SQLite, LangGraph, LangChain and FastAPI, transforming a previously rule-based chatbot approach into workflow-oriented conversational automation integrated with internal APIs and citizen-service complaint registration processes.

Led development of a public-facing citizen-service chatbot initiative integrated with WhatsApp workflows, enabling citizens to register complaints through natural-language interactions instead of relying exclusively on call centers, in-person service or limited application workflows.

Designed workflow orchestration and automated testing strategies for AI-driven conversational flows, enabling validation of chatbot behaviors, workflow reliability and API integration consistency before production adoption.

Engineered Python and Pandas-based metadata mining solutions capable of extracting and centralizing knowledge from a legacy PostgreSQL database containing 148 tables, creating the organization’s first centralized database dictionary and accelerating onboarding, system comprehension and query reliability across the engineering team.

Reverse engineered undocumented business rules and system behaviors from legacy applications, database structures and proprietary framework artifacts available only as compiled JAR files, translating critical operational knowledge into scalable and maintainable service-oriented solutions.
Designed API integration patterns and batch-processing workflows focused on fault tolerance, data consistency and interoperability between legacy systems, modern services and external integrations.
Audited and resolved cross-system data inconsistencies through architectural improvements and process redesign initiatives, improving reliability of operational and citizen-service data flows.

Defined and implemented the organization’s first automated testing strategy, introducing end-to-end, integration and unit testing practices that significantly improved release confidence, reduced regression risk and enabled safer modernization efforts.

Led technical planning, backlog structuring and architectural discussions for a multidisciplinary engineering team of six developers, aligning delivery priorities with modernization goals, operational stability and stakeholder requirements.

Acted as the primary technical bridge between engineering teams, city hall stakeholders, executives and third-party maintainers, translating complex operational and business requirements into scalable technical solutions and modernization roadmaps.

Designed end-to-end system features including data models, API contracts, frontend-backend interaction flows and service integration patterns, ensuring maintainability, scalability and alignment with long-term architectural goals.
